rationale: InstanceUserReceiver.TryCreate reports the diagnostic when meta.Receiver or ExpressionFactory.Receiver is used for a declaration that has no receiver, and the message names the target and the reason. The message is consistent with LAMA0114. The title only lacks its final period.
codeChange: In InstanceUserReceiver.TryCreate, when GetClosestMemberOrNamedType returns a named type, the reason 'the target NamedType is static and is not an extension method' is false (the type is not necessarily static); a reason such as 'the target is a type, not a member' would be accurate (same issue as LAMA0114). Also, the 'the target {kind} is static' branch of the extension-block case is unreachable because the case pattern already requires IsStatic: false, so static extension-block members fall into the default branch.
